sources.values: EPC90133BOM.xlsx (checked by scripts/epc90133_schematic.py against the recorded file)
sources.precedence: BOM part numbers set values; schematic labels are checked against them and differences are recorded, not resolved

label_discrepancies.treatment: simulated as uP1966E from its datasheet; the label difference is unresolved (EPC9097's schematic shows the same one)
EPC2302 vendor model; the schematic value looks like a typo

default_population_notes: No synchronous-boot option (QSG default): R77 fitted, R60 and D77 empty, so the driver supply net labelled '4.7 V' equals VCC (5 V).
D1, D2, C70, C75, J1, J2, J32, R11, R22, L1, Cout are optional or user-fitted and are not part of the stock board.

nets.VIN: bus input, Ci1-Ci7 and Cm1-Cm10 top terminals, Q1 drain
nets.GND: power ground: Q2 source, capacitor returns, mid-layer 1 return plane
nets.SW: switch node: Q1 source, Q2 drain
nets.VSWN: U80 high-side return, tied to SW
nets.VDRV: U80 VDD, the net labelled '4.7 V' (5 V in the default population)

components.note: HF loop capacitors; DC-bias derating not applied
intermediate capacitors; DC-bias derating not applied

transcribed_not_simulated.reason: synchronous bootstrap supply for 5VHS1; the bench uses an ideal floating high-side supply as the EPC9097 bench did. Diode orientations in this network were not confirmed from the drawing.
